info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/hyper3d/rodin/v2
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/hyper3d/rodin/v2 queue.

preview_render.description: Generate a preview render image of the 3D model along with the model files.
preview_render.title: Preview Render

quality_mesh_option.description: Combined quality and mesh type selection. Quad = smooth surfaces, Triangle = detailed geometry. These corresponds to `mesh_mode` (if the option contains 'Triangle', mesh_mode is 'Raw', otherwise 'Quad') and `quality_override` (the numeric part of the option) parameters in Hyper3D API.
quality_mesh_option.title: Quality Mesh Option

material.description: Material type. PBR: Physically-based materials with realistic lighting. Shaded: Simple materials with baked lighting. All: Both types included.
material.title: Material

addons.description: The HighPack option will provide 4K resolution textures instead of the default 1K, as well as models with high-poly. It will cost **triple the billable units**.
addons.title: Addons

use_original_alpha.description: When enabled, preserves the transparency channel from input images during 3D generation.
use_original_alpha.title: Use Original Alpha

geometry_file_format.description: Format of the geometry file. Possible values: glb, usdz, fbx, obj, stl. Default is glb.
geometry_file_format.title: Geometry File Format

seed.description: Seed value for randomization, ranging from 0 to 65535. Optional.
seed.title: Seed

bbox_condition.description: An array that specifies the bounding box dimensions [width, height, length].
bbox_condition.title: Bbox Condition

input_image_urls.description: URL of images to use while generating the 3D model. Required for Image-to-3D mode. Up to 5 images allowed.
input_image_urls.title: Input Image Urls

TAPose.description: Generate characters in T-pose or A-pose format, making them easier to rig and animate in 3D software.
TAPose.title: T/A Pose

examples: A futuristic robot with sleek metallic design.
prompt.description: A textual prompt to guide model generation. Optional for Image-to-3D mode - if empty, AI will generate a prompt based on your images.
prompt.title: Prompt

model_meshes.description: Additional generated 3D object files returned by Hyper3D besides model_mesh.
model_meshes.title: Model Meshes

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size
